Installing this bundle auto-installs all four presets (v1 was removed at v2.0.0). Each preset also writes a FINAL PAPER by default when its run concludes — and does so BEFORE the run is marked complete: on v4/v5 the team co-authors its parts, merges them, cross-reviews, and the editor named by paperEditor finalises; the output is Paper/<run or institute id>/{paper.md,paper.tex,paper.pdf when a LaTeX engine is detected,paper.meta.json,paper.log.md} (params finalPaper/paperFormat/paperLanguage/paperCompilePdf/paperLatexCommand, plus paperEditor on v4/v5; see docs/final-paper.md).
